brief.subject: Shift bill due dates to match payday; FTC fights playground deal
brief.headline: Bills Due Before Payday? Ask to Move the Due Date. Plus: FTC Sues to Block Merger
brief.dek: Changing bill due dates can smooth cash flow, and the FTC is suing to stop a playground-equipment merger it says would hurt competition.
brief.lede: If your bills land before your paycheck, asking billers to change the due date is one simple way to ease the cash crunch.

sections.heading: Bills Due Before Payday
bullets: Requesting a new due date from billers can help align payments with when your paycheck arrives.
Better-timed due dates can make monthly cash flow easier to manage and reduce last-minute scrambles.

sections.heading: FTC Sues to Block Playground Merger
bullets: The FTC sued to stop PlayPower, owned by Platinum Equity, from acquiring rival playground maker BCI Burke.
The agency says the two are among the largest makers of commercial outdoor playground equipment.
Regulators argue the deal would weaken price and quality competition in an already concentrated market.
